name: coldstorage_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for cold storage service authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: coldstorage_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT book storage. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: coldstorage_check_eligibility
description: Checks eligibility for cold storage infrastructure support. Group-based (FPO/cooperative) applicants have priority; individual farmers may have limited eligibility. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if applicant type is unsupported or scheme criteria not met.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_submit_application
description: Submits an application for cold storage/cluster infrastructure support. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate application, or incomplete project details.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_get_facility_list
description: Returns list of existing cold storage facilities in a region. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Includes facility details, types, and operational status. Does NOT check capacity availability. Fails if location invalid or no facilities found.

name: coldstorage_check_capacity
description: Checks available storage capacity at a specific facility. Returns capacity_status ('available', 'limited', 'full') with available space. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book storage. Fails if facility_id invalid or facility not operational.

name: coldstorage_book_storage
description: Books storage space at a cold storage facility. Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Facility must have available capacity and commodity must be compatible. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee space until confirmed. Fails if capacity full, commodity-temperature mismatch, or duplicate booking.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_track_booking
description: Tracks booking_status ('requested', 'confirmed', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify booking. Fails if booking_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_release_storage
description: Releases stored commodities and closes the booking. Transitions booking_status to 'completed'. Booking must be 'active'. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify records. Fails if booking not active or storage duration violated.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_get_project_status
description: Tracks project_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'operational') for infrastructure applications. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify project. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_cancel_booking
description: Cancels a storage booking. Only possible when booking_status is 'requested' or 'confirmed'. Requires session_token. Fails if already active or completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_get_nearest_facility
description: Returns the nearest cold storage facilities with distance and capacity info. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book storage. Fails if location invalid.

name: coldstorage_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance. Categories: 'application_rejected', 'facility_unavailable', 'booking_issue', 'storage_damage', 'delay_in_approval'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.

name: coldstorage_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks cold storage grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.
